title: Claude agents calculate a first-order Hawking–Page transition at weak coupling
summary: Claude research agents calculated a negative three-loop quartic coefficient in the studied weak-coupling model, supporting a first-order Hawking–Page transition. The work reports theoretical calculations checked against known special cases and an independent Claude computation; it is not an empirical observation about the universe.
ai_technology: Claude research agents for Hamiltonian calculations

evidence.tested: The paper reports the weak-coupling Hamiltonian calculation and negative three-loop quartic coefficient; checks include known special cases and an independent Claude computation.
evidence.unknown: The result is theoretical and limited to the model and weak-coupling regime studied.
evidence.ai_role: Claude agents carried out Hamiltonian computations and checked the coefficient; physicists guided and reviewed the work, and Claude helped draft the paper.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
